server.name: io.github.Grinv/steam-games-mcp
server.description: Steam store/game data (no key) plus player profiles, libraries and achievements (Steam Web API).

environmentVariables.description: Free Steam Web API key (optional). Unlocks player profile, library and achievement tools.
environmentVariables.name: STEAM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Default player: 17-digit SteamID64 or vanity name (the part after /id/).
environmentVariables.name: STEAM_ID

environmentVariables.description: Two-letter ISO country code for store prices (e.g. US, GB, DE).
environmentVariables.name: STEAM_COUNTRY

environmentVariables.description: Store language (e.g. english, russian, german).
environmentVariables.name: STEAM_LANGUAGE

server.name: io.github.Grinv/tmdb-mcp
server.description: MCP server for The Movie Database (TMDB) with IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings via OMDb.
server.title: TMDB MCP Server

environmentVariables.description: Required. TMDB v4 'Read Access Token' from themoviedb.org/settings/api (sent as a Bearer token).
environmentVariables.name: TMDB_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Free key from omdbapi.com — enables IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings.
environmentVariables.name: OMDB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Default response language as ISO-639-1, optionally with a region (e.g. ru-RU, en-US, ja).
environmentVariables.name: TMDB_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Default ISO-3166-1 country code (e.g. US, RU, GB) for region-specific results.
environmentVariables.name: TMDB_REGION
